title: Basic Quickstep to learn for fun at home

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teachers teach as a couple, alternating between demonstrating together and breaking down individual roles. They use friendly humor and conversational instruction to explain footwork and turns.

lesson_structure.note: Teachers introduce themselves and the dance
Demonstrating leader and follower basic steps

steps_taught.name: basic step
steps_taught.description: 8-step basic including quarter turn and progressive chasse

steps_taught.name: spin turn
steps_taught.description: natural spin turn with strong step and brushing action

quotes.text: Quickstep which is quite challenging to fit in a really small space
That's a bit of a marathon, isn't it?
The key to get it going is to make sure we work it really well together.

evidence_segments.observation: Male teacher demonstrates leader basic steps facing away from camera
Female teacher demonstrates follower basic steps facing away

extraction.distinctive_method: Breaking down partner dances by teaching leader and follower parts separately while facing away from the camera so students can mirror easily.
